notes: Literature numbers the paper quotes, each checked against its primary source on 2026-09-25. Values are as printed in the source. 'third-party retrainings 23.5-24.0' is accurate only for PAL (23.97) and issue #66 (23.59); FusionNet's 23.50 is most likely the released wo_perc weights evaluated without GT mean.
